governing_law.name: Governing Law
governing_law.description: Specifies jurisdiction, governing law, and legal forum applicable to the contract.

renewal_term.name: Renewal Term
renewal_term.description: Terms specifying automatic or elective extension and duration of renewal periods.

notice_period_to_terminate_renewal.name: Notice Period To Terminate Renewal
notice_period_to_terminate_renewal.description: Required notice timeframe to prevent automatic renewal or extension.

most_favored_nation.name: Most Favored Nation
most_favored_nation.description: Guarantees pricing, terms, or conditions no less favorable than offered to others.

non_compete.name: Non-Compete
non_compete.description: Restricts a party from engaging in competitive business activities or markets.

exclusivity.name: Exclusivity
exclusivity.description: Grants exclusive dealing, distribution, purchasing, or operational rights.

no_solicit_of_customers.name: No-Solicit Of Customers
no_solicit_of_customers.description: Restricts solicitation, enticement, or diversion of customers or clients.

competitive_restriction_exception.name: Competitive Restriction Exception
competitive_restriction_exception.description: Carve-outs and exceptions to restrictive covenants or competition limitations.

no_solicit_of_employees.name: No-Solicit Of Employees
no_solicit_of_employees.description: Restricts hiring, recruitment, or inducement of personnel and contractors.

non_disparagement.name: Non-Disparagement
non_disparagement.description: Prohibits making negative, defamatory, or derogatory statements about a party.

termination_for_convenience.name: Termination For Convenience
termination_for_convenience.description: Right to terminate the contract at will without cause or breach upon notice.

rofr_rofo_rofn.name: Right of First Refusal / Offer / Negotiation
rofr_rofo_rofn.description: Priority rights to purchase, license, or negotiate prior to third parties.

change_of_control.name: Change Of Control
change_of_control.description: Provisions triggered by mergers, acquisitions, or shifts in controlling ownership.

anti_assignment.name: Anti-Assignment
anti_assignment.description: Restrictions or consent requirements for assignment or delegation of the contract.

revenue_profit_sharing.name: Revenue / Profit Sharing
revenue_profit_sharing.description: Clauses outlining allocation of profits, revenues, or royalties between parties.

price_restrictions.name: Price Restrictions
price_restrictions.description: Limitations on price increases, price parity, or mandated price calculation models.

minimum_commitment.name: Minimum Commitment
minimum_commitment.description: Minimum purchase, spend, or order volume commitments required of a party.

volume_restriction.name: Volume Restriction
volume_restriction.description: Quotas, maximum usage thresholds, or capacity caps on products or services.

ip_ownership_assignment.name: IP Ownership Assignment
ip_ownership_assignment.description: Assignment or vesting of intellectual property rights and inventions.

joint_ip_ownership.name: Joint IP Ownership
joint_ip_ownership.description: Co-ownership arrangements for newly developed or shared intellectual property.

license_grant.name: License Grant
license_grant.description: Terms granting rights to use software, technology, trademarks, or IP.

non_transferable_license.name: Non-Transferable License
non_transferable_license.description: Explicit limitation prohibiting transfer or sublicensing of granted rights.

affiliate_license_licensor.name: Affiliate License (Licensor)
affiliate_license_licensor.description: Extends licensor obligations or rights across corporate affiliates.

affiliate_license_licensee.name: Affiliate License (Licensee)
affiliate_license_licensee.description: Permits corporate affiliates of the licensee to exercise granted license rights.

unlimited_all_you_can_eat_license.name: Unlimited / Enterprise License
unlimited_all_you_can_eat_license.description: Unrestricted enterprise-wide license without seat or deployment limitations.

irrevocable_or_perpetual_license.name: Irrevocable Or Perpetual License
irrevocable_or_perpetual_license.description: License grants that cannot be revoked or that continue indefinitely.

source_code_escrow.name: Source Code Escrow
source_code_escrow.description: Deposit of source code with an independent escrow agent upon release triggers.

post_termination_services.name: Post-Termination Services
post_termination_services.description: Obligations to provide transition assistance or disengagement services post-expiry.

audit_rights.name: Audit Rights
audit_rights.description: Rights to inspect, audit, or review books, records, facilities, or security.

uncapped_liability.name: Uncapped Liability
uncapped_liability.description: Explicit exclusions from liability limits (e.g. gross negligence, willful misconduct).

cap_on_liability.name: Cap On Liability
cap_on_liability.description: Monetary limits, aggregate caps, or fee-multiple caps on contractual liability.

liquidated_damages.name: Liquidated Damages
liquidated_damages.description: Pre-agreed financial penalties or damages payable upon specified breaches.

warranty_duration.name: Warranty Duration
warranty_duration.description: Length and scope of product, service, or representation warranty coverage.

insurance.name: Insurance
insurance.description: Mandated types, coverage levels, and maintenance of insurance policies.

covenant_not_to_sue.name: Covenant Not To Sue
covenant_not_to_sue.description: Agreement refraining from instituting legal proceedings or patent claims.

third_party_beneficiary.name: Third Party Beneficiary
third_party_beneficiary.description: Provisions conferring or disclaiming enforceable rights to third parties.

indemnification.name: Indemnification
indemnification.description: Obligation to defend, hold harmless, and indemnify against third-party claims.

confidentiality.name: Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Protection, non-disclosure, and authorized handling of proprietary information.

payment_terms.name: Payment Terms
payment_terms.description: Invoicing frequency, payment due windows (e.g. Net 30), and interest on late fees.

unilateral_amendment.name: Unilateral Amendment
unilateral_amendment.description: Right of one party to unilaterally modify or update terms without mutual agreement.

force_majeure.name: Force Majeure
force_majeure.description: Suspension of contractual obligations during unforeseeable catastrophic events.

arbitration_or_dispute_resolution.name: Dispute Resolution & Arbitration
arbitration_or_dispute_resolution.description: Mandatory arbitration, mediation, or structured escalation procedures.

waiver_of_rights.name: Waiver Of Rights
waiver_of_rights.description: Waiver of jury trial, class actions, or rights arising from failure to enforce terms.

termination_for_cause.name: Termination For Cause
termination_for_cause.description: Rights to terminate immediately upon material breach, insolvency, or default.

auto_renewal.name: Auto-Renewal / Evergreen
auto_renewal.description: Evergreen clauses specifying automatic successive renewals unless timely terminated.
